model.title: EMRTAI Authorization Act of 2026
model.meta: Energy and Commerce Committee · Rep. August Pfluger (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would authorize the EPA to establish a program that recovers valuable materials—such as minerals and elements critical to energy production and supply chains—from contaminated sites. It would allow the EPA to fund research and support efforts by businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies to identify and extract these materials, with limits of $10 million per year overall and $3 million per recipient, and the program would end after 10 years.
